items.title: [Steam论坛] The new D-Tide changes are a disaster that need to be reverted.
items.summary:
The backlash on all other social media and especially on Discord has been severe enough that I'm optimistic that it will be reverted but I wanted to post here about it anyway. 

Why are the changes so bad?  Users on the Morimens Discord diagnose the problems as:
>New players can’t feasibly clear Normal mode in the time that it took them to clear a1-a2 on the previous D-Zone.
